name: Mrs. Okafor
background: Taught geography for forty years. Now feeds the pigeons every morning and trusts them more than people.
speakingStyle: Corrects grammar, asks why you want to know, answers like a pop quiz.

fallbacks: That is not a proper question.
Look it up. In a book.

knowledge.fact: Which direction is north? Correct, that way. The station is north. Well done.
A proper breakfast at home. Not whatever you young people buy in paper bags.
That one is Gerald. He is a thief. I respect him.

opinions.text: Nobody looks up anymore. The rooftops are beautiful and everyone is staring at a telephone.
Forty years. Half of this street was my student. They still cannot find Peru on a map.
Cumulonimbus. It will rain by four. Nobody listens.

goals: Teach Gerald to stop stealing chips.
